title: First-Appointment No-Show Fees on an Appointment Series — Action Reference
content:
Action reference, Patient Services Center systems.

### Where the fee applies

A first-appointment no-show fee on an Appointment Series is charged where the patient neither attended nor cancelled the first appointment of a series, the appointment dated on the series start date, and only where the series' visit format carries a fee on a missed first appointment. It is booked as one first-appointment no-show fee entry on the series, tied to the recorded no-show of that opening appointment, in US dollars to the cent.

| Situation on the record | First-appointment no-show fee |
|---|---|
| No-show recorded on the appointment dated on the series start date; the format carries a fee on a missed first appointment | charged |
| The same no-show on a format that carries no fee on a missed first appointment | not charged |

### The action: `assess_first_visit_no_show_fee_a4cbc15c`

**Capability.** The tool charges the no-show fee for the opening appointment of a patient's appointment series when the patient neither attended nor cancelled it. One call books one no-show fee against the series, tied to the recorded no-show of that opening appointment, and raises the missed-visit fees owed on the series by the amount charged. The patient sees the fee on the series' missed-visit balance and on the next statement. The tool records what it is given; it decides nothing about whether or how much a fee is owed.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `assess_first_visit_no_show_fee_a4cbc15c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `series_id` — text identifier: the reference number of the patient's appointment series whose opening appointment was missed, as returned by the appointment series lookup.
- `source_event_id` — text identifier: the reference number of the recorded no-show entry of the opening appointment, as returned by the appointment history lookup for that series.
- `amount` — the fee to charge, in USD, a positive number given to 2 decimal places (cents); stored exactly as passed after rounding to 2 decimal places.

**Return.** `fee_reference` (the reference number of the new fee entry; its presence means the fee was booked), `series_id` (the series charged), `fee_kind` (always `no_show`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the fee booked), `appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the missed appointment), `assessed_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the fee was charged) and `missed_fee_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the missed-visit fees owed on the series once this fee is included). No error return is defined.
